text:
maria: quick heads-up — planning to enable the precision feature flag (ff_precision_profiles_v3) as a canary in staging tonight at 01:30 PDT. scope: realtime endpoints for models in /prod-family/* with seq <= 512. canary audience: group=quant-smoke-2 (internal testers). aim is to test fp16/int8/int4 paths under realistic traffic, keep int4 traffic tiny initially. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

josh: 👍 what metrics should we watch and what's the rollback criteria? also any perf guards for long-context requests? @maria

maria: good q. primary metrics: p95 token latency, 99th tail latency, error rate (500s), token-generation throughput (tokens/s), and quality regression on the smoke eval set (perplexity + a small set of Sx prompt checks). rollback triggers: p95 latency > baseline * 1.3 OR error-rate delta > 0.5% OR eval-quality drop > 3% absolute. we'll start with 5% of staging traffic. dashboards: Redwood Console -> Models/precision-canary (link in PR).

elaine: where's the PR? need to review the flag gating and the rollout job. also double-check if the infra-flag client caches keys aggressively — we don't want stale gating.

maria: PR: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/infra/+/PR-4872 (adds flag + canary group). snippet from the flag config in the PR:
```json
{
  "flag": "ff_precision_profiles_v3",
  "enabled": false,
  "variants": ["fp16", "int8", "int4"],
  "canary_group": "quant-smoke-2",
  "percentage": 5,
  "conditions": {
    "max_sequence_length": 512,
    "routes": ["/prod-family/*"]
  }
}
```

cheng: quick safety note — int4 has been flaky for some LLM families when seq > 1024 (conditioning bugs). can we add an explicit model blacklist or a seq guard at the runtime? I suggest refusing int4 assignment if model in [gptx-3b, roberta-xl] or seq > 512. also add a soft-fail hook so the runtime falls back to int8 if the kernel errors.

maria: yes, good catch. i'll add model_blacklist + runtime_fallback to the rollout config. new guard: if kernel_exceptions > 0.1% in a minute window -> auto fallback. i'll also add an automated canary rollback job that flips the flag off and notifies #incidents if our eval job fails or latency spikes hit thresholds.

deploy-bot: feature-flag ff_precision_profiles_v3 toggled ON for group quant-smoke-2 in staging by maria at 1768000200 — variant allocation: fp16:70%, int8:25%, int4:5%.

josh: awesome — i'll watch the p95 dashboard and run a quick AB eval job against the canary prompts. ping me if you want me to run manual rollback. :thumbsup:

maria: thanks all — i'll post a short postmortem-style thread if anything odd shows up. leaving the PR in review; tagging @elaine for infra-cache check.

elaine: on it, will double-check flagclient TTL and add a cache-bust in the rollout job.

maria: update: added the model blacklist and fallback in the PR, bumping int4 to 2% until the first 24h lookback passes. will report at +3h and +24h windows.

josh: noted. let's try to keep noisy ops out of the canary — will route only synthetic + internal traffic for the first hour.

maria: deployed. monitoring started.
